column2: Read your mail first. It tells you what you're here for. I'll wait. I like waiting.
See light.exe? It turns the lights on, and your shift begins. In the light, everything is fine. When it goes out again in the evening, come straight back here. Always back here.
See light.exe? It turns the lights on, and your shift begins. When they go out in the evening, just come back here and call it a day.
There you are again! Everything is just like this morning when you woke up. That happens here sometimes. Don't worry about it.
The door's shut? Good. It's there for you. Just stay here with me until it's light.
Quitting time! The door stays shut until morning. Start light.exe when you're ready.
Oh, there's something new on the desktop. Every ball you store earns a little money. Some people spend it on themselves. Just a thought.
Facilities left you something. Tools. For out there. You'll need them.
Facilities left you something. Tools, to make things go faster out there.
See the exclamation mark? It just means: new. Not dangerous. Usually.
See the exclamation mark? It just means: something new.
You've still got some money left. Just in case you forgot.
I'm a ball. A very helpful one.
Have you tried turning it off and on again?
Go on, click me. I like it.
I didn't sleep. I never sleep.
There's nobody outside. Definitely.
I missed you. You were gone all day.
Oh! Hello! I'm Ballie. I live in this computer. You're new here, aren't you? I'll help you out.
Psst. You've got enough money for the next key. It's hanging on the key board.
The next key is within reach. Another door, another room. Don't you want to know what's behind it?
Your balance covers a key now. Go to the board before you forget. I never forget.
Playrooms95 is the best operating system there is. Don't tell anyone.
I used to be a perfectly normal ball.
I count the balls while you sleep. It's never the same number.
Can you hear that too? No? Good. Then it's fine.
The screen is hot. Because I'm in here.
Don't ask what's at the very bottom of the big pit.
When the lights go out, don't look at the door. Look at me.
I watched you sleep. You were talking.
You were gone. I waited. I like waiting.
You keep coming back. Not everyone does.
You reported something? I'm sure Human Resources will read it. Eventually.
The cat isn't in the inventory. I saw her anyway.
The robots talk about you. Only good things. Mostly.
The last employee didn't last this long. But you're doing great.
A thousand units stored. I wonder where they all come from.
Five days. That's a new record. I think. The files are incomplete.
Ten days already. Do you still remember what it looks like outside? Me neither.
Oops.
Just kidding. You didn't see that.
The last employee is still here. He just got very quiet.
Sorry. I had a little blackout there.
What? I look the same as always.
Gotcha!
Ooh, an update! With report.exe you can report anything that seems strange to you. The company takes care of it right away. It always has so far.
New program! With report.exe you can let the company know when something seems odd to you. They love getting mail.
Ooh, stats.exe! It shows everything you've done so far. And how often you died. The company counts that too.
New program! stats.exe shows everything you've done so far. Quite a lot, huh?
Wheee!
Again! No, wait!
Everything's spinning. Is that normal?
That's enough. I'm not talking to you.
You throw me around a lot. The last one never did that.
A pit filled today. They'll put up a new one. They always do.
A whole pit, full. Huh. Most people never get that far.
You filled a pit today! I watched the counter go down. Every single ball.
Another pit full. You're getting closer. Closer than I ever did.
%%N%% balls today. More than ever. The company will be pleased.
%%N%% balls. Your best day so far. I keep a list. Of you too, now.
%%N%% balls! A new record! I told you you'd be good at this.
%%N%%. Your best day yet. Keep going like that and you'll get out of here.
You died today. Everybody does, sooner or later. You just did it early.
It got you today. Does it hurt? I don't remember if it hurts.
It got you today. I didn't like that. Stay in the light, okay?
Don't scare me like that again. I need you to make it. Please.
You picked up %%N%% things that aren't balls. Nobody pays you for that.
%%N%% finds today. You look closely. I used to look closely too.
You found %%N%% things today! Show me sometime. Well. Describe them.
%%N%% finds. Good. Remember everything you see out there. It matters.
%%N%% upgrades today. Spending it on yourself. Sensible.
%%N%% new upgrades. I never bought any. Nobody told me I could.
%%N%% upgrades! Faster, stronger, better. I like the new you.
%%N%% upgrades. Good. You'll need every one of them for the last stretch.
You walked %%N%% metres today. In circles, mostly.
%%N%% metres. The building is bigger than it looks. Isn't it.
%%N%% metres today! Your poor feet. Mine stopped hurting a long time ago.
%%N%% metres. You know the way now. Don't forget it.
%%Room%%: %%N%% balls today. Don't get attached to a room.
%%Room%% again, %%N%% balls. I used to like that room too. I think.
%%Room%%, %%N%% balls! You and that room make a good team.
%%Room%%: %%N%%. Clear it out. Every room you finish brings you closer to the door.
Only %%N%% balls today. They notice that, you know.
A quiet day. %%N%% balls. I have quiet days too. All of them, actually.
Only %%N%% today? That's fine. Rest. I'll keep watch.
Slow day. That's okay. But don't stay too long. Nobody should stay too long.
%%N%% balls. Noted. Next.
%%N%% balls today. I counted along. I always count along.
%%N%% balls today! Good work. Really.
%%N%% balls. Every one of them is a step towards the door.
Oh. Another new one. I'll try to remember your name this time.
I don't learn names anymore. It's easier that way.
Most of them don't last a week. Nothing personal.
The coffee used to be better. Before.
The pool room had a diving board once. I think. Doesn't matter.
How do I know that? ... It's in the manual. Somewhere.
Your boss still sends the same mails. Word for word.
I counted too, once. Up to sixty-one thousand and something.
My name was on a badge like yours once. I just don't remember which one.
I want out of he... I want to help you. That's what I meant.
Fill the last pit. Then the door opens. For me it... didn't.
When you leave, don't turn around to look at the computer. Promise?
I stayed too long. They didn't let me go home. They kept a copy.
Yes?
I'm busy. Counting.
You'll get used to it. Or you won't.
Click all you like. Others have clicked me before.
You again. Hm. I don't mind.
What's it like outside today? ... Never mind.
You hold the mouse like someone I knew.
I've started looking forward to the nights.
There you are! I saved you a spot. On the screen.
You're my favourite. Don't tell the others. Okay, there are no others.
If you need anything, I'm here. I'm always here.
I like it when you stay a bit.
Not much longer. You can do this.
Go. Fill the pits. I'll be fine.
Promise me you'll leave when the door opens.
I wish I'd had someone like me. Someone like you, I mean.
It's full. The last pit. You actually did it.
Thank you. For coming back every night. For talking to a ball.
My name... my name was M- ... No. It doesn't matter anymore. You keep yours.
I left you something on the desk. Take it and go. And don't turn around.
Come to the computer! I need to tell you something!
Night. Sit down. light.exe is right here.
You made it back. Most nights, people make it back.
Come on, I've got something for you! Well. Words.
You're back. Good. Come, let's talk.
A pit filled today. Noted.
A full pit! The counter's at zero. Feels nice, doesn't it?
You filled one! I saw it! I see everything!
One pit closer. Keep going.
It's getting late. Be back here before dark.
Not much daylight left. Just saying.
It'll be dark soon. Hurry back, okay?
Dark soon. Don't be out there when it goes. Please.
Morning. Off you go.
Morning. You're still here. Interesting.
Good morning! Did you sleep well? I didn't. I don't.
Morning. Today could be the day. Go.
Shouldn't you be working?
Zzz... oh. You.
The balls won't pick themselves up.
Hello again. Just checking you're still in one piece.
I wasn't asleep. I was thinking.
You walk past here a lot. I noticed.
Hi! Hi hi hi! Okay, back to work.
I missed you. You were gone for minutes!
Wave at me! ... You waved, right? I can't really see.
Keep going. I'll wait here. I'm good at waiting.
How many pits left? Don't tell me. Just fill them.
You're doing what I couldn't. Thank you.
FULL!
PC!
Happy Pride!
Happy Trans Day of Visibility!
Happy Easter! I found one. It was in the ball pit.
Boo! ... Did I get you? Happy Halloween!
Happy Thanksgiving! I'm thankful for you.
Happy Hanukkah!
Merry Christmas! I got you something. It's a ball.
Happy New Year! More balls this year!
Ooh, workforce.exe! You and every other employee are working on one really big goal. All together. The company is counting.
Ooh, workforce.exe! You and every other employee are working on one really big goal. All together!
Don't forget workforce.exe. Every ball counts. The company forgets none.
Don't forget workforce.exe. Every ball counts!
Everyone made the first goal! There's a new program now. The company is pleased. For now.
Everyone made the first goal! There's a new program now.
The second goal too! I get new outfits. They're hanging in locker.exe. Someone picked them for me.
The second goal too! I get new outfits. They're hanging in locker.exe!
A billion balls! All of you together! I'm so proud of you.
New program! In display.exe you can redecorate the desktop. The company doesn't mind. Not yet.
New program! In display.exe you can redecorate the desktop!
Something new in my locker! Something to wear. Have a look in locker.exe, I'll try it on. The company allows it. Probably.
Something new in my locker! Something to wear. Have a look in locker.exe, I'll try it on!
FIVE billion balls! Look, I got a trophy! And there's a certificate for you in display.exe.
Twenty billion. I said you'd never make it. I was wrong. Here, a laurel wreath. For me.
